title: Contact-form incident register
scope: Preserved errors, access obstacles, browser-control limitations and uncertain outcomes from the reviewed October 25–26 logs. Includes recovered cases. Counts are routes with recorded issues, not proven undelivered messages, and not a failure rate. No new submissions made.
method: Combined initial attempt notes, EML-matched outcomes, alternative-route outcomes and latest saved queue; kept earlier issue history alongside later acknowledgments. Research-only leads, ordinary CAPTCHA presence, declined forms and routes with no observed error were excluded. Broader coverage than the original three-case report; not complete server telemetry. Local source paths are relative to the Government receipt inquiries folder. Raw private screenshots/logs remain local; public entries are redacted extracts.
